steps.title: Prepare culture tube cap
steps.instruction: Cut a hole into the cap of the culture tube to create a tunnel-like opening.

steps.title: Create funnel from 5 mL pipette tip
steps.instruction: Cut a 5 mL pipette tip at both ends to form a funnel.

substeps.instruction: At the slim end, cut along the small indent where the tip broadens.
At the broader end, cut 0.5 cm below the grooves.

steps.title: Create strut from 1 mL pipette tip
steps.instruction: Cut a 1 mL pipette tip to create a strut.

substeps.instruction: At the slimmer end, cut slightly above the visible line on the tip.
At the other end, cut right along the end of the grooves.

steps.title: Prepare Promega PureYield Minicolumn
steps.instruction: Remove and discard the cap of the Promega PureYield Minicolumn.

substeps.instruction: Remove the cap by either cutting as indicated in the reference figures or by cutting off the hinge while the cap is closed.

steps.title: Assemble the demi-spinner
steps.instruction: Assemble the prepared components into the final demi-spinner configuration.
